description: Use for 'what does DORA require?', DORA compliance checklists or gap reviews. Returns the core DORA (Regulation (EU) 2022/2554) requirements for financial entities, grouped by section with the article for each, leaving out those that DORA itself disapplies for microenterprises or for entities under the simplified ICT risk management framework of Art. 16.

microenterprise.description: The financial entity is a microenterprise (DORA Art. 3(60))

simplified_framework.description: The entity is listed in DORA Art. 16(1) and uses the simplified framework

title: DORA requirements checklist
